plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Ashland University '4-YEAR PLAN for the BACHELOR OF SCIENCE MAJOR in EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT & HOMELAND SECURITY' (B.S. in Homeland Security, Comprehensive Major; Traditional and ONLINE; Four-Year Curriculum Guide AY 25/26, rev. 7/25). 8 semesters x 15 credits = 120 credits. Placeholder slots (CORE, HSEC Elective, ELECTIVE) are choice:true with the guide's own slot labels as codes and catalog-worded choice_notes. Prereqs are not stated on the 4-year guide and are therefore omitted; course-level prereqs live in the catalog course descriptions. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school, no published TCCNS/articulation). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
